title: The Sleeping Cluster
description: A routine maintenance window appears to have left the cluster effectively powered down. The API is unavailable, control plane nodes are NotReady, and customer traffic is failing before it reaches workloads.

incidentTicket.title: Customer cannot reach API after overnight maintenance
incidentTicket.description: Monitoring and customers report repeated API timeouts after a maintenance window. No user-initiated platform changes are recorded after the window closed.
incidentTicket.customerImpact: Administrators cannot log in to the cluster and application rollouts are blocked.
